reader.requirement: At --std 85 (format as amended by X3.23b-1993: no ellipsis on statement-1/statement-2) statement-1 and statement-2 of IF must each be present when written (or be NEXT SENTENCE as the whole alternative) and be either an imperative statement (one or more consecutive imperative statements, delimited-scope statements included) or a conditional statement optionally preceded by imperative statements; an empty THEN or ELSE operand, and NEXT SENTENCE written beside another statement, is refused. The witness covers only the empty consequent before END-IF.
reader.edition-search: ifStatement is one grammar rule (IF condition THEN? statementBlock (ELSE statementBlock)? END_IF?) with statementBlock = statement+, no edition predicate; the NEXT SENTENCE arm reader IsNextSentenceArm reads the parse shape only. Grepped StatementBinder.cs NEXT SENTENCE arm and the grammar for Edition/CobolVersion/IsAvailable predicates: none. The only edition read near the path is VersionConformancePass.VisitNextSentenceStatement (the 2023 archaic warning COBOL0903), which does not decide this rule.

reader.notes: statementBlock is statement+, so an empty operand is a parse refusal naming the unbracketed operand; a conditional statement's own phrases absorb what follows it, so 'a conditional statement optionally preceded by an imperative statement' is the only shape a parsed block can take. NEXT SENTENCE is admitted only as the whole arm.
